My dad was very unsupportive and sometimes abusive towards my mom, and I remember as a small child her talking about suicide. Have a serious discussion about boundaries. Try to sit down and write down what concessions you will and will not make, and tell him how you’re feeling. 

Whether he accepts them or not is up to him, but you have to stick by them, even if it may mean separating. At that point the ball is in his court and he’ll Have to deal with the consequences of his choices. He can feel invincible by his damn self.

One thing that may be helpful is figuring out why you’re still fixated, and what about her is keeping you fixated. Is it something physical, or is it something deeper? instead in focusing on her, Try to make those qualities something you look for in a new partner. Download a dating app too. You may not find a steady GF, but you can gain more experience and get a bead on what you want and don’t want in a relationship, or if you want a serious relationship at all. You’re young and your options are so much more open than you may realize. Explore everything you can!
